row.title: The branch sweep's records are its write-back
row.body: Every branch sweep PR changes ops/branchsweep-ledger.jsonl and generated dashboard data and files PORT-BRANCH items; writeback check accepted docs/issues/OL- items but not these, so sweep PR 702 failed with no write-back. WB-SWEEP-1: docs/issues/PORT-BRANCH- and ops/branchsweep-ledger.jsonl count as write-back; tests/foundation/test_writeback.py covers it.

title: The branch sweep's records are its write-back
